title: intercontinental-uwf-slam-1999
label: Deathstalker

won.source: Won a title defense the promotion's own 28 July 1999 report previewed against champion Rockin' Rebel, scheduled for early August 1999; no result document survives, but the promotion's own 18 November broadcast frames this as a completed reign that fell short of a third.

lost.note: Lost the title to Mike "Showtime" Bradshaw seeking what the promotion's own broadcast calls a third Intercontinental reign; the match itself is not read for this record.

note: A two-time former champion; this reign, recorded from the promotion's own repeated billing, is his second.

title: intercontinental-uwf-slam-1999
label: Rockin' Rebel

won.source: Billed as the reigning UWF Intercontinental Champion in the promotion's own 21 July 1999 report.

lost.source: Lost the title to Deathstalker in a defense the promotion's own 28 July 1999 report previewed for early August 1999; the result itself is not read for this record.

note: Lost the title to Deathstalker, not directly to Mike "Showtime" Bradshaw; a further reign held the title between this one and Bradshaw's own.

won.source: Billed as the reigning UWF European Champion in the promotion's own 21 July 1999 report.

lost.source: The promotion's own 18 November 1999 broadcast bills Shogun Assassin as the new champion; no result document for the change survives in the held record.

won.source: The promotion's own 18 November 1999 broadcast states Bradshaw "took out" the champion Deathstalker, denying him a third reign, within Bradshaw's own first month of competition; the match itself is not read for this record.

title: ultimate-uwf-slam-1999
label: "Big D" Devestation

won.source: Billed as the reigning UWF Ultimate Champion on the promotion's own 18 November 1999 broadcast; no result document for the title change survives in the held record.

note: Recorded from the promotion's own repeated billing, per the standing precedent for a title a card bills as held without a surviving result.

title: european-uwf-slam-1999
label: Shogun Assassin

won.source: Billed as the reigning UWF European Champion on the promotion's own 18 November 1999 broadcast; no result document for the title change survives in the held record.

note: Facing a guaranteed challenger, Great Numpty, and a tied co-challenger, Saint, in a title match previewed for the promotion's own 20 November 1999 broadcast; no result survives in the held record.
